images.caption: Where's that track going? Spurn Point, East Riding of Yorkshire, England.The track is from the first world war to supply a base on Spurn protecting the mouth of the Humber. It now aims at Humber mudflats, indicating the shifting of Spurn Point - it is actually growing seaward at this point.

images.caption: Spurn Railway, Spurn Point, East Riding of Yorkshire, England.The railway was built to transport supplies to the camp near the end of the peninsula.  The trains were wind powered!  As Spurn Point is constantly on the move westwards, most signs of the railway have disappeared.  This is one spot where the tracks crossed the concrete road and is some evidence of the former railway.
